rfis.question: The new platform bolts through the web of two existing mall beams (detail C-10) and of beam B4 (guides E1/E2). We can't drill until the mall's engineer approves in writing. DLG said on 11/4 the approval is "in process."

rfis.question: The drawings give two different hazard classes, and the suggested heads don't fit.
